text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d the f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t s-a-m-p-l-e-s and f-a-c-e t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s f-r-o-m the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t c-o-n-s-o-l-e, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-e-d e-x-p-o-r-t f-i-l-e as the only trace, and the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g a-u-d-i-t w-a-s the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-a-l-s-e i-d e-n-t-r-y in the h-r d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y u-s-i-n-g the a-d-m-i-n o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a p-e-n-d-i-n-g a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l t-o-k-e-n as the only trace, and the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n w-a-s the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
3) the a-c-t-o-r p-r-i-n-t-e-d a p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l b-a-d-g-e for the f-a-l-s-e i-d at the s-h-o-w-r-o-o-m p-r-i-n-t-e-r, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a p-r-i-n-t j-o-b e-n-t-r-y as the only trace, and the b-a-d-g-e i-s-s-u-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w w-a-s the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-w-r-o-t-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s to s-h-o-w the f-a-l-s-e i-d as a-n-a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a b-a-c-k-u-p s-h-a-d-o-w c-o-p-y as the only trace, and the i-m-m-u-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y h-a-s-h c-h-e-c-k w-a-s the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e f-i-l-e-s in the i-c-c r-e-p-o-s-i-t-o-r-y to i-m-i-t-a-t-e a c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a s-e-a-l s-t-a-m-p m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a as the only trace, and the r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y r-e-v-i-e-w w-a-s the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
